journal.name: 03-puzzle-journal
journal.scene: Direction 3: Open puzzle journal. An open large Japanese stitched paper journal rests on a dark wooden veranda table, viewed directly from above with no perspective distortion. Its pale facing pages fill the central grid region. A narrow vertical binding seam runs down the exact center between the two groups of four columns, never across a puzzle slot. Small sakura petals lie on the dark wooden desk around the margins. The two pages are blank and nearly flat cream, subtle pixel shadows at edges. A simple bookmark ribbon hangs near the bottom outer edge. Warm contemplative literary mood.

start.name: 04-sakura-courtyard
start.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Commander X16 Kakuro game splash-screen draft. Generate ONE standalone full-screen landscape image, 4:3 aspect ratio, designed as a 640x480 pixel canvas. Authentic carefully composed retro pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, hard edges, no antialiasing, no photographic textures or smooth gradients. Rich Japanese scenery with cherry blossoms. Limit the whole design to approximately 16-24 flat colors selected ONLY from this actual CX16 palette subset: #111122 #222244 #334466 #445588 #5566aa #99aacc #bbccff #ffeebb #ffffff #ffbbbb #cc9999 #886666 #664444 #443322 #221111 #ffbbee #cc99cc #aa88aa #776688 #554466 #334433 #556644 #778866 #99aa88 #bbcc99 #668844 #dd8855 #880000 #cc3333 #ff7777 #ccaa33 #88aaaa #446666. Use a smaller coherent subset, not every color. Pixel steps should remain readable at 640x480. Clear polished title-screen hierarchy. Exact text: "KAKURO" as a prominent legible custom pixel lettering title in the upper central region, and "PRESS ENTER" in smaller pixel letters near bottom center. No other text, no watermarks, no device frame, no comparison grid. Calm negative space behind text, beautifully balanced scenery around it. This is a visual draft for later implementation, not a technical diagram. Scene: intimate traditional Japanese courtyard seen from the shade of an open wooden veranda. Dark timber posts at the outer edges and a thin roof eave at the top frame the image naturally. Low wooden railing along the bottom, a cherry tree blooming beside a small stone lantern and koi pond, bamboo and a simple wooden garden fence in the distance. Muted sage greens, cream sunlight, dusky pink blossoms, warm dark timber. Leave an uncluttered softly colored central background for the title. Mood: cozy, contemplative, inviting. No people.
